comment: Baseline for the n8n importer regression corpus. Tiers: imported = n8n.Import returned no error; activatable = workflow.Compile returned no error; runnable = the workflow ran to completion with HTTP, SQL and model calls stubbed. Regenerate with go test ./internal/interop/n8n/corpus -update-baseline, and say in the commit which workflows moved and why.
